source_group_definition.primary: LeetCode original file field, namespaced as leetcode:<exact file value>; a source-problem label, not proof of statistical or semantic independence
source_group_definition.calcite: All397 pairs inventoried; benchmark/index is not independent rule/test provenance. Exclude primary selection with SOURCE_GROUP_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
source_group_definition.literature: All64 pairs inventoried; name groups aggregate related variants only. Mark upstream-rewritten non-natural engineering controls, not primary source groups. Do not use to fill shortages.

reserve_exclusion.origin: Four identities already known from this data-registration agent historical context; no reserve file reread
reserve_exclusion.procedure: Stream each original source line as bytes and hash it; decode only JSON metadata prefix before top-level pair, obtain file label and C classification, compare group SHA. On reserve match do not decode pair SQL or tokenize it; expose only opaque group hash and counts. Prefix insufficiency remains a recorded failure/uninspected state.
reserve_exclusion.privacy_limit: Workflow exclusion, not cryptographic confidentiality or OS isolation. Whole frozen source bytes necessarily pass through file/line hasher; reserve SQL values are not decoded/tokenized/displayed.

lexical_rules.scope: Mutually exclusive first matching stratum per original pair, matching if either original query satisfies the rule. JSON decoding and tokenization only, not an SQL parser, AST, binding or semantic validation.
lexical_rules.tokenization: Ignore comments/whitespace; quoted strings are literal tokens, quoted identifiers are never keywords. Count balanced parentheses only. Unrecognized characters/unbalanced lexical parentheses retained as inventory failures, not repaired.
lexical_rules.relation_hints: Original-schema table names lexically after FROM, JOIN, or comma at tracked FROM depth; optional schema.table suffix. Not verified aliases/scopes. Derived/CTE table aliases not assumed to be physical tables.
lexical_rules.S2_DERIVED_TABLE_AGGREGATE: FROM or JOIN immediately followed by ( SELECT; an aggregate-call token exists before its matching parenthesis.
lexical_rules.S3_IN_EXISTS_OR_CORRELATED_HINT: IN/EXISTS immediately followed by ( SELECT, or multiple SELECT tokens plus same qualified-name prefix observed both at depth0 and deeper. The latter is only a possible correlation hint, not verified correlation.
lexical_rules.S5_SELF_OR_REPEATED_RELATION: A declared base-table name appears more than once among lexical relation references.
lexical_rules.S6_MULTI_JOIN_3_TABLES: At least3 distinct declared base-table names among lexical relation references within one query.
lexical_rules.S7_JOIN_AGGREGATE: JOIN keyword or at least2 lexical relation occurrences, plus an aggregate-call token.
lexical_rules.S8_PURE_JOIN_NONAGGREGATE: JOIN keyword or at least2 lexical relation occurrences, and no aggregate-call token in that query.
lexical_rules.known_biases: First-match gives complex shapes precedence. Some nested/quoted/dialect constructs may be unrecognized; tokenization failures and shortages are reported. No support/eligibility/meaning inference follows.

selection.pair_preservation: Keep original source_record values, both SQL, all schema, original C including absent field, original source labels, raw line hash/locator. No SQL simplification, mutation, inferred labels or C repair.
exclusions_before_shape_selection: four opaque known reserve source groups
selection.complexity: Per pair sum over both queries: token_count +8*max(0,SELECT_count-1)+4*JOIN_keyword_count+4*aggregate_call_count+4*set_operation_count.
selection.within_group_stratum: Sort original candidate pairs by (token_complexity, SHA256(seed+NUL+PAIR+NUL+source_group+NUL+sql0hash+NUL+sql1hash+NUL+rawlinehash), rawlinehash); choose lower median at floor((n-1)/2), not shortest.
selection.within_stratum: Visit group representatives ordered by SHA256(seed+NUL+GROUP+NUL+stratum+NUL+source_group), tie exact group ID.
selection.cross_stratum: Visit8 strata in fixed priority. A group selected in an earlier stratum cannot be selected again; unselected groups may compete in another stratum via that stratum median.
selection.cross_group_SQL_dedup: If either representative raw SQL SHA matches an already selected group SQL, reject that representative and continue stable group order. Do not choose another pair from the rejected group×stratum. Within-pair byte identity already excluded.
selection.cap: Accept first4 eligible unique groups per stratum; log all later representatives as cap-not-selected. Never fill an empty stratum from other datasets or a second group variant.
selection.not_outcome_conditioned: No solver/test labels, SQL outputs, applicability statuses, prior case verdicts, or semantic results inspected or used. Failure after selecting/rereading an exact representative invalidates it or whole scan, never triggers replacement.

contract_source_axis.PRESENT_JSON: nonempty list of nonempty clause objects; their semantics/provenance remain unverified
contract_source_axis.EXPLICIT_EMPTY_OPERATIONAL: literal []; benchmark explicitly provides an empty operational C list, not evidence of absent business rules
contract_source_axis.NULL_UNSPECIFIED: literal null; extra operational C unspecified, never automatically treated as validated no-business-constraints
contract_source_axis.MISSING: constraint key absent; preserve source_record without adding key; constraint_sha256=null
contract_source_axis.RESERVED_METADATA_UNINSPECTED: reserve metadata prefix does not establish C field; do not decode SQL to infer it

selected_record_interface.downstream: worker consumes --case-index into immutable selected.jsonl; never resamples or guesses missing C. Null/missing slots retain contract-source-insufficient status rather than replacement.

outputs: inventory.jsonl (every source row, reserve SQL excluded)
source_groups.json (all established labels and opaque excluded group counts)
report.json (all denominators, constraints classes, source identity, shortages, failures and resources)
exposure: Entire source family already exposed by older48910-slot applicability scans. Selected data are current development/probing material, not hidden or unseen tests. Labels do not certify natural origin or statistical independence.
business_scope: Benchmark-declared C can support explicit official operational-encoding diagnostics; C provenance/business truth remains unknown and cannot establish a real business bottleneck.
authoring_validation: Only stdlib metadata reading, file writing and Python ast.parse syntax check. Scanner main has not run and source data have not been newly scanned under this protocol.
resource_guard_interface: Parent static_guard.py creates fresh03/runs/RUNOUT and supervisor receipt/stdout/stderr; worker accepts that directory only if its own output files are absent, never overwrites supervisor files.

selected_output_binding.write_mode: Both exclusive-create; same unchanged case bytes. Refuse launch if canonical output already exists.
selected_output_binding.downstream: --case-index selects exact line in canonical frozen JSONL; no sampling.

inventory_integrity_gates: All3 actual source SHA/bytes/rows equal old frozen identities
LeetCode C-axis classes sum23994 and NULL_UNSPECIFIED count957, else no validated selection
Exactly4 known opaque reserve source-group hashes encountered and excluded, else no validated selection
All selected SQL/schema/C/raw-line identities match exact original records
